name: Kiss or Kill
source:
Kiss or Kill is a romance & suspense visual novel that fuses a dating show with a deadly battle royale. Win their hearts, or watch them die. In this 7-day AI dating show, every choice decides who lives, who loves, and the truth behind it all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4676960/Kiss_or_Kill/]Steam[/url]]
